summary: Letta Code (@letta-ai/letta-code) is a TypeScript/Bun-built, Node-run coding-agent CLI whose entrypoint is the bundled letta.js (built from src/standalone-entry.ts by build.js). It normally talks to Letta Cloud, but it ships an in-process "local backend" (LETTA_LOCAL_BACKEND_EXPERIMENTAL=1 / --backend local) that drives LLM providers directly through the @earendil-works/pi-ai library. Provider connections for the local backend are stored in <LETTA_LOCAL_BACKEND_DIR>/providers/auth.json via `letta --backend local connect <provider> --api-key ... --base-url ...`; for the built-in "anthropic" provider the stored base_url is passed verbatim as baseURL to the Anthropic SDK, so the harness POSTs to $PROXY_URL/v1/messages?beta=true (streaming, with tool definitions). The pi-ai "openai" provider uses the Responses API, so the Anthropic route is used. One task runs non-interactively with `letta -p --new-agent --yolo --model anthropic/<claude id> --output-format stream-json "$TASK"`, which creates a fresh local agent, auto-approves tools, streams JSONL events to stdout and exits; the local backend also persists the full conversation transcript (messages.jsonl) under LETTA_LOCAL_BACKEND_DIR, which the recipe points at /out. Verified in Docker on both python:3.12-slim-bookworm and buildpack-deps:jammy against a mock Anthropic server.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=python:3.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

# Letta Code overlay: self-contained Node 22 + Bun toolchain under /opt/harness,
# source copied to /opt/harness/src and bundled there with the repo's own build.
ARG NODE_VERSION=22.19.0
ARG BUN_VERSION=1.3.14
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# make/g++ are only needed when node-pty has no prebuild for the arch (e.g. arm64);
# python3 (needed by node-gyp in that case) comes from the base image.
RUN set -eux; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      ca-certificates curl git xz-utils unzip ripgrep procps make g++; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN set -eux; \
    arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "$arch" in \
      amd64) node_arch=x64; bun_arch=x64 ;; \
      arm64) node_arch=arm64; bun_arch=aarch64 ;; \
      *) echo "unsupported architecture: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/node /opt/harness/bun /opt/harness/bin; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${node_arch}.tar.xz" \
      | tar -xJ -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1; \
    curl -fsSL -o /tmp/bun.zip "https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v${BUN_VERSION}/bun-linux-${bun_arch}.zip"; \
    unzip -q /tmp/bun.zip -d /tmp/bun; \
    mv "/tmp/bun/bun-linux-${bun_arch}/bun" /opt/harness/bun/bun; \
    chmod +x /opt/harness/bun/bun; \
    ln -s bun /opt/harness/bun/bunx; \
    rm -rf /tmp/bun /tmp/bun.zip

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:/opt/harness/bun:$PATH

COPY . /opt/harness/src

# bun install applies the vendored Ink patches (postinstall); `bun run build`
# bundles src/standalone-entry.ts -> /opt/harness/src/letta.js and copies bundled skills.
RUN set -eux; \
    cd /opt/harness/src; \
    export CI=true HOME=/tmp/harness-build-home; \
    bun install --frozen-lockfile; \
    bun run build; \
    printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /opt/harness/node/bin/node /opt/harness/src/letta.js "$@"\n' > /opt/harness/bin/letta; \
    chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/letta; \
    rm -rf /tmp/harness-build-home

# Non-interactive, offline-friendly defaults for the local (pi-ai) backend.
ENV LETTA_LOCAL_BACKEND_EXPERIMENTAL=1 \
    DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 \
    DO_NOT_TRACK=1 \
    LETTA_CODE_TELEM=0 \
    LETTA_CODE_OFFLINE=1 \
    LETTA_SKIP_KEYCHAIN_CHECK=1 \
    LETTA_FS_SANDBOX=0 \
    LETTA_DISABLE_MODS=1 \
    CI=true
run_command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p /out; letta --backend local connect anthropic --api-key proxy --base-url "$PROXY_URL" >/dev/null && letta --backend local -p --new-agent --yolo --model "$LETTA_HARNESS_MODEL" --output-format stream-json "$TASK" | tee /out/letta-stream.jsonl
notes: Routing: the harness has no ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL hook (neither letta-code nor pi-ai read it), so the proxy URL is stored per run with `letta --backend local connect anthropic --api-key proxy --base-url "$PROXY_URL"`; that record goes to $LETTA_LOCAL_BACKEND_DIR/providers/auth.json and is passed as the Anthropic SDK baseURL, so requests hit $PROXY_URL/v1/messages?beta=true (beta messages endpoint, streaming, anthropic-beta headers, tool definitions). The proxy must tolerate the ?beta=true query string. Model: LETTA_HARNESS_MODEL is a recipe-only variable consumed by run_command; the value must be an `anthropic/<id>` handle present in pi-ai 0.87.1's catalog (claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-opus-4-5/4-6/4-7/4-8, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-fable-5/5-1, claude-opus-5/5-5, claude-sonnet-4-6/5). The OpenAI provider is avoided because pi-ai's "openai" provider speaks the Responses API, not chat completions. Outputs: stdout is stream-json (init/message/result events) and is tee'd to /out/letta-stream.jsonl; the local backend writes the full conversation transcript to /out/letta-local-backend/conversations/*/messages.jsonl plus agent/memfs state. --new-agent creates a fresh local agent per run with memfs (a local git repo under LETTA_LOCAL_BACKEND_DIR; git identity is set by the harness); --yolo sets permission mode "unrestricted" so Bash/Edit/Write run without prompts; stdin is not read because the prompt is positional. Build notes: node-pty ships a linux-x64 prebuild; on arm64 it compiles with node-gyp (hence make/g++, python3 from the base image); the bun zip lacks a bunx symlink, which build.js needs for `bunx tsc`. Verified end to end in Docker on both python:3.12-slim-bookworm and buildpack-deps:jammy against a mock Anthropic streaming server: `letta --version` -> 0.32.19, connect exit 0, headless run exit 0 with the mock's text returned as the result.
